digest.component_or_area: Import parser help and CLI documentation generation
propositions: Import help documentation describes obsolete duplicate-creation and future-batching behavior instead of current 256-event chunk batching, deferred push, and source-based resumption

Canonical import parser help must be updated to document current batching (independent create, parent, file-impact, verify-command, and comment passes per 256-event chunk) and per-event link and status passes before generated artifacts are regenerated
Generated packaged help, overview help, and CLI reference must be regenerated from the canonical parser help to match current importer behavior
User guidance must explicitly state that whole-file atomicity is not provided and partial tickets are not automatically completed after crashes or concurrent imports
